description: Exceptions to the effective Compose controls of root and LAB services (SPEC-0218). scripts/validation/compose_controls.py renders every model and accepts a deviation only through an entry naming its exact scope, compose_file, service, control and allowed_value. Jobs (restart: no) need no healthcheck and a service that reads no secret needs no Docker secret; those are lifecycle facts, not exceptions.

controls.cap_add: cap_add is empty; an exception names the exact capability list
controls.restart: a daemon restarts unless-stopped or always; a job uses no
controls.secrets_group: group_add carries SECRETS_GID exactly when the service reads a Docker secret or a bind under a secrets directory
controls.init: init is true so a signal-forwarding init reaps child processes
controls.gpu: a GPU device reservation needs an exception naming the service
controls.pids_limit: a PID limit is set (template tier budget or leaf override)

exceptions.reason: The official postgres entrypoint chowns the data and socket directories, then drops to the postgres user with gosu
exceptions.impact: Root in the container can change file ownership and switch user until the entrypoint drops privileges
exceptions.mitigation: cap_drop ALL first; no-new-privileges; the server runs as postgres
exceptions.verification: HOME container healthy with this set on 2026-10-09
exceptions.release_condition: Remove when the data directory is pre-owned and the image starts directly as postgres

exceptions.reason: Restic reads data volumes owned by many service users and the pgBackRest repository owned by UID 70
exceptions.impact: The backup process can read every mounted file regardless of mode
exceptions.mitigation: Read-only source mounts; no network for the backup run; run only by the backup timer
exceptions.verification: Nightly hyhome-backup runs (RUN-0021)
exceptions.release_condition: Remove when every backed-up tree is readable through a backup group

exceptions.reason: The offsite copy reads both local repositories whose files are owned by root and UID 70
exceptions.impact: The process can read any mounted file
exceptions.mitigation: Read-only repository mounts; egress only to the configured R2 endpoint
exceptions.verification: Offsite copy contract (ADR-0041, RUN-0021)
exceptions.release_condition: Remove when the repositories are readable through a backup group

exceptions.reason: The export reads SQLite stores owned by other service users and writes staging files owned for Restic
exceptions.impact: The export can read and re-own mounted files
exceptions.mitigation: Networkless one-shot job; only the SQLite stores and staging are mounted
exceptions.verification: Nightly hyhome-backup runs (RUN-0021)
exceptions.release_condition: Remove when the stores and staging share a backup group

exceptions.reason: Stalwart binds SMTP 25 and submission 587 inside the container as a non-root user
exceptions.impact: The process can bind ports below 1024 inside its network namespace
exceptions.mitigation: No host port is published; internal mail network only
exceptions.verification: StalwartRehearsalTests (opt-in)
exceptions.release_condition: Remove if the listeners move to ports above 1024

exceptions.reason: The one-shot job writes the replica-set keyfile and hands it to UID 999
exceptions.impact: The job can re-own files on its mounted key volume
exceptions.mitigation: LAB only; one-shot; only the key volume is mounted
exceptions.verification: SPEC-0215 TSK-0002 MongoDB LAB run
exceptions.release_condition: Remove if the keyfile is generated by a job running as UID 999

exceptions.reason: Existing /openbao/data group-write compatibility is retained; native audit also writes /openbao/audit, whose HOME ownership and capacity need verification.
exceptions.impact: The exact readonly /openbao/tls/server-key.pem bind grants backend TLS identity-key access to this service; /openbao/audit holds sensitive HMAC audit records. This is not a no-secret mount.
exceptions.mitigation: TLS materials use a dedicated path outside shared DEFAULT_CERT_DIR; only exact CA files reach clients. Server key binds are readonly, audit remains declared with HMAC and 0600 files; no permission widening is authorized.
exceptions.verification: HOME mount ownership read on 2026-10-09 (owner 1000, group 1000, mode 775; container uid differs); SPEC-0204 TSK-0006 SOURCE/ISOLATED bind and UID checks; HOME TLS/audit permissions remain unverified
exceptions.release_condition: Remove the shared group exception only after data, audit and TLS key access use verified service ownership or dedicated groups; preserve native TLS and audit custody during rollback.

exceptions.reason: The service writes /openbao/agent and /openbao/out (token sink and rendered files), owned 1000:1000 mode 775 by the host user; group 1000 is its only write path
exceptions.impact: The container also holds the secret-reading group, though it mounts no secret
exceptions.mitigation: No secret file or secrets directory is mounted into this service
exceptions.verification: HOME mount ownership read on 2026-10-09 (owner 1000, group 1000, mode 775; container uid differs)
exceptions.release_condition: Remove once the data directory is owned by the service user or a dedicated data group
